title: Local Officials Celebrate SkyLINE Grand Opening at Rancho Bernardo Transit Station
description: SAN DIEGO - SkyLINE is a new, mixed-use, transit-oriented development located at the Rancho Bernardo Transit Station in San Diego. Developed through a partnership between Affirmed Housing and MTS, SkyLINE replaces a portion of an existing Metropolitan Transit System (MTS) parking lot with a seven-story affordable housing development featuring 100 apartment homes, approximately 14,000 sq. ft. of office space and replacement parking stalls for MTS patrons.
